nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the current contract owner, set from msg.sender in the constructor and used for the onlyOwner authorization check.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address used by the two-step transferOwnership/acceptOwnership handover.
IFC.symbol: ERC20 token ticker, set to "IFC" in the constructor.
IFC.name: ERC20 token name, set to "Insurance Fintech" in the constructor.
IFC.decimals: token decimal precision, set to 18 in the constructor.
IFC._totalSupply: total token supply assigned to the deployer address in the constructor.
IFC.balances mapping: per-address token balance ledger read and written by transfer/transferFrom.
IFC.allowed nested mapping: owner to spender allowance ledger written by approve/approveAndCall and consumed by transferFrom.
SafeMath.safeAdd: pure addition with an overflow check on the result.
SafeMath.safeSub: pure subtraction guarded by require(b <= a) to prevent underflow.
SafeMath.safeMul: pure multiplication with a division-based overflow check.
SafeMath.safeDiv: pure division guarded by require(b > 0).
Owned constructor: sets owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged account.
Owned.transferOwnership: onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership: verifies msg.sender == newOwner, transfers ownership and resets newOwner.
IFC constructor: initializes metadata, mints the whole supply to a fixed address and inherits the Owned constructor.
IFC.totalSupply: returns _totalSupply minus the balance of address(0).
IFC.balanceOf: returns balances[tokenOwner].
IFC.transfer: moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
IFC.approve: writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] without an explicit return-value warning.
IFC.transferFrom: moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and decrements the spender allowance via safeSub.
IFC.allowance: returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
IFC.approveAndCall: sets the allowance then calls an arbitrary spender contract's receiveApproval.
IFC fallback function: payable but immediately reverts, rejecting all direct ETH transfers.
IFC.transferAnyERC20Token: onlyOwner rescue of foreign ERC20 tokens via an external call to tokenAddress.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance keys and as the target of external calls.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) with an attacker-controlled callee and no reentrancy guard.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) whose return value is forwarded without validation and whose callee is arbitrary.
Subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub; the arithmetic that backs every balance and allowance decrement.
Addition c = a + b inside safeAdd; the arithmetic that backs every balance increment.
Multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul with a division-based overflow guard.
